duration.text: The Communication Engineering at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) You can download a template or sample from here. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. Personal Statement (500 words) Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English.

requirements.text: The applicant should be under the age of 25 with good health and must have academic transcripts and a diploma equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate. He /She may be recruited after examination and approval by the University. All undergraduates are proficient in English.
